## Next Move
1. Inspect current `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `game.js`, then implement age progression and sci-fi playable races plus Rick and Morty guide UI/dialogue.
2. Run syntax checks and browser gameplay verification, correcting the mobile tile-selection test.
3. Save and inspect a latest small JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game screens and UI markup.
- `styles.css`: Responsive game presentation.
- `game.js`: Game rules, factions, rendering, and interactions.
- `/tmp/opencode/game.jpg`: Latest successful desktop screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
